Q: Building a RAG chatbot where users can upload their own documents mid-conversation — how are you guys handling this? A:

Duda Nogueira from Weaviate here :)

Multitenancy is a good option here. Specially because you will not want to search multiple sessions in one query and do want this isolation.

For real-time indexing, you will need to turn INDEX_ASYNC off, as this can pile up and increase the delay. Indexing is a CPU bound process, so you will need to make sure it has what it needs to index fast.

If using INDEX_ASYNC, you can monitor the indexing queue of the tenant shard to display a READY status, other than INDEXING status.

Considering you may only get a relatively small amounts of vectors per tenant/session, you can test indexing speeds for flat/hnsw index on different scale levels so you can choose a better strategy and if dynamic index (flat until a threshold, then it becomes hnsw) makes sense.

for global KB + session docs, you will likely need a query router/agent, to decide if the question is on global KB or session docs.

And for follow-up and context aware questions, a memory could help tackle that.

By the way, we already provide a builtin Query Agent in Weaviate Cloud, and we are also working on another toolset for exactly the issues you are facing. ;)

Thanks!

Q: Excel - paste special HTML option A:

This is a bit of code but seems to function OK. It uses Ron de Bruin's RangetoHTML function to create an HTML representation of the range to be copied, then adds a "magic" wrapper which signals to Excel that the HTML format is available, and adds the wrapped HTML to the clipboard.

Background on the HTML "wrapper" at this link: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/dataxchg/html-clipboard-format#:~:text=The%20CF_HTML%20clipboard%20format%20allows,based%20on%20IE4/MSHTML%20implementations.

See https://jkp-ads.com/rdb/win/s1/outlook/bmail2.htm for the RangetoHTML function.

Sub TestCopyRangeAsHtml()
    
    Dim html As String, ws As Worksheet
    
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    
    html = RangetoHTML(ws.Range("B2:E6")) 'See https://jkp-ads.com/rdb/win/s1/outlook/bmail2.htm
    set_clipboard_text wrapHTML(html)     'put wrapped HTML in the clipboard
    
    ws.Range("G2").Select    'must select before pasting
    ActiveSheet.PasteSpecial 'paste as HTML
End Sub

'See: https://stackoverflow.com/a/63735992/478884
'The "wrapper" lets Excel know the format is HTML
Private Function wrapHTML(ByVal html As String) As String
    Dim sData As String
    Const sContextStart = "<HTML><BODY><!--StartFragment -->"
    Const sContextEnd = "<!--EndFragment --></BODY></HTML>"
    Const sHtmlHeader = _
            "Version:1.0" & vbCrLf & _
            "StartHTML:<{]aaaaaaa" & vbCrLf & _
            "EndHTML:<{]bbbbbbb" & vbCrLf & _
            "StartFragment:<{]ccccccc" & vbCrLf & _
            "EndFragment:<{]dddddddd" + vbCrLf
    sData = sHtmlHeader & sContextStart & html & sContextEnd
    sData = Replace(sData, "<{]aaaaaaa", Format(Len(sHtmlHeader), "0000000000"))
    sData = Replace(sData, "<{]bbbbbbb", Format(Len(sData), "0000000000"))
    sData = Replace(sData, "<{]ccccccc", Format(Len(sHtmlHeader & sContextStart), "0000000000"))
    sData = Replace(sData, "<{]ddddddd", Format(Len(sHtmlHeader & sContextStart & html), "0000000000"))
    wrapHTML = sData
End Function

'https://stackoverflow.com/a/78329329/478884
Function set_clipboard_text(str_text)
    On Error GoTo err_handler
    Dim MSForms_DataObject As Object
    Set MSForms_DataObject = CreateObject("new:{1C3B4210-F441-11CE-B9EA-00AA006B1A69}")
    MSForms_DataObject.SetText str_text
    MSForms_DataObject.PutInClipboard
    Set MSForms_DataObject = Nothing
    set_clipboard_text = True
    Exit Function
err_handler:
    Debug.Print "error in set_clipboard_text function. Err: " & _
    Err.description
set_clipboard_text = False
End Function

Q: Parent-child table with linked list under parent: can the CTE be reduced? A: 
with recursive r as(
  select 0 rlvl
    ,0 tlvl
    ,0 root
    ,0 parent,0 child,0 prev,0 next
    ,concat('0','') path
    ,0 sib_idx
  from map t
  where parent=0 and prev is null
  union all
  select rlvl+1 rlvl
    ,case when t.child =r.next then tlvl else tlvl+1 end tlvl
    ,case when t.child =r.next then r.root else t.parent end root
    ,t.parent, t.child, t.prev, t.next
    ,concat(r.path,'(',case when t.child =r.next then r.sib_idx+1 else 1 end,')',t.child) path
    ,case when t.child =r.next then r.sib_idx+1 else 1 end sib_idx
  from r inner join map t 
  on t.child =r.next 
    or (t.parent=r.child and t.prev is null) 
  where rlvl<40
)
select   parent, child, prev, next
  ,substr('..........',1,tlvl*3) || child figure
  ,rlvl, tlvl, root
  ,sib_idx
  , path
from r 
order by path 
;

Q: Can you create feature branch from main and than merge it to develop branch? A:

If you want to have some long lived branches with ongoing development of "large" features, it sounds like you might want to have a "real" develop branch for those features. At the beginning of the development cycle, synchronize develop with main (it will be so by definition if new code is merged to main from develop after testing). Then create feature branches off of develop, just as you have described, and when ready test it (be careful about allowing new commits while testing) and finally merge it back into prod. If testing takes a lot of time then consider using some kind of release branch to isolate the code that will be promoted. You can still have a "hotfix" strategy for small features that you want to deploy to prod on short notice (in which case, however, do not test develop, test the feature branch that was created from prod, and then be sure the "hotfix" is also added to develop afterwards - exactly as Sven Kroll explained). This would allow you to have several features being worked on by more than one developer at the same time, which could then all be tested and deployed together.
